2610.12445.title: Caught in the Act: Probes Effectively Detect Sabotage and Catch Unverbalized Deception
2610.12445.paper_summary: Recent incidents have highlighted the challenge of monitoring LLM agents and the danger of models deceiving people. We show that white-box deception detection via probes can be scaled up to frontier monitoring settings by collecting the largest deception dataset to date for training probes and introducing a novel probe architecture which can aggregate information across many layers and tokens. Our probes achieve 98.8% AUC in SHADE-Arena, surpassing an Opus 5.5 text-monitoring baseline, and show improved efficacy as the underlying model is scaled up. To push our probes to their limit, we test them on several cases where deception cannot be determined from the context alone. In these cases, which we refer to as introspective deception, the ground truth can only be determined through careful elicitation or thorough knowledge of a model's training data. In one such evaluation, we show that probes can distinguish transcripts containing a model's true hidden goal from other goals with an AUC of up to 99.7%. Our probes also readily detect deception on prominent open-weight models which lie about politically sensitive topics, and about their beliefs when put under pressure. We release our training dataset, dubbed FIBS, to help drive frontier deployment of effective probes, and encourage the community to expand upon it with further examples of deception and sabotage.
2610.12445.paper_summary_zh: 最近的事件突顯了監控 LLM 代理的挑戰以及模型欺騙人類的危險。我們顯示通過探針的白盒欺騙檢測可以擴展到前沿監控設置，方法是收集迄今為止最大的欺騙數據集來訓練探針，並引入一種新穎的探針架構，可以在多層和多個標記之間聚合信息。我們的探針在 SHADE-Arena 中達到了 98.8% 的 AUC，超越了 Opus 5.5 的文本監控基準，並顯示出隨著基礎模型的擴展，效能有所改善。為了將我們的探針推向極限，我們在幾個情況下進行測試，在這些情況下，僅從上下文無法確定欺騙。在這些情況中，我們稱之為內省欺騙，真實情況只能通過仔細引導或對模型訓練數據的透徹了解來確定。在其中一次評估中，我們顯示探針可以區分包含模型真正隱藏目標的轉錄本與其他目標，AUC 高達 99.7%。我們的探針還能輕易檢測出在政治敏感話題上撒謊的顯著開放權重模型，以及在壓力下對其信念的表述。我們發布了名為 FIBS 的訓練數據集，以幫助推動有效探針的前沿部署，並鼓勵社群以更多的欺騙和破壞例子來擴展這一數據集。
